# Dynatrace to Acquire AI Observability Leader Arize
BOSTON & SAN FRANCISCO--(BUSINESS WIRE)-- [Dynatrace (NYSE: DT)](https://www.dynatrace.com/), the leading AI-powered observability platform, has signed a definitive agreement to acquire [Arize](https://arize.com/) in a cash and stock transaction valued at $915 million.

web.title: Dynatrace acquires Arize, accelerates AI observability efforts
web.description: Dynatrace acquired Arize, which specializes in AI observability and the AI development lifecycle, in a deal worth $915 million.

# Dynatrace to acquire Arize in $915M AI observability deal
[Dynatrace has agreed to acquire AI observability company Arize](https://ir.dynatrace.com/news-events/press-releases/detail/435/dynatrace-to-acquire-ai-observability-leader-arize) in a cash and stock transaction valued at $915 million, bringing AI evaluation and production observability under the same platform.
